・Feature for creating new wallet keys: A new feature for users to generate new wallet keys directly from the command-line interface. It will use cryptographic algorithms to ensure the security and uniqueness of each key. Users will be able to generate both public and private keys. The algorithms used will match the required for signing Cardano transactions. This feature is required for many of the basic wallet functionality to be developed in further milestones.
・Feature for restoring wallet from a seed phrase: A feature to enable users to restore their wallet using a seed phrase. The seed phrase is a list of words which store all the information needed to regenerate the private key that controls the wallet. ・New feature for building transaction using low-level primitives: A feature that enables users to construct a transaction using low-level primitives or basic elements. This manual approach offers maximum flexibility and control over the transaction details at the cost of extra complexity. Users can specify inputs and outputs, set transaction fees, and add metadata through the command-line interface. The feature should include validation checks to ensure the transaction's correctness and handle any potential errors gracefully, providing clear and informative error messages to guide the user.
・New feature for building transactions from intents: A feature that simplifies the transaction building process by allowing users to specify their intent or high-level actions they want to perform,
